# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 05 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale — Record Prices Across the Board

- **Million-dollar HDB resales hit third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats changed hands for at least S$1 million in October 2026, up from 209 in September, making up 10.9% of total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **First S$1.8M HDB resale flat recorded — a 5-room unit in Queenstown** - A 5-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson sold for S$1.818 million, becoming the first flat in Singapore to cross the S$1.8 million mark on both absolute price and psf basis. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

- **Tampines executive flat sells for record S$1.275M** - An executive flat at Tampines Palmspring changed hands for S$1.275 million, setting a new price record for executive flats in Tampines and ranking as the town's second highest HDB resale across all flat types. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/tampines-palmspring-executive-flat-record-1-275-million/)

## Private Market — New Launch and Pricing Trends

- **Thomson Reserve sold 1,143 units in 2 days at 90% take-up** - All 3-bedroom and 4-bedroom units were sold at launch, leaving 123 two-bedders and 2 five-bedroom suites remaining, priced from S$1.635M. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/thomson-reserve-sold-1143-units/)

- **CCR-RCR price gap is the narrowest since 1998** - Prime (CCR) resale condos now cost just 1.19x city-fringe (RCR) ones per sq ft, the smallest gap between the two regions in nearly three decades. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/prime-resale-condos-cost-1-19x/)

## BTO — November 2026 Launch Now Open

- **November 2026 BTO launch offers 7,964 flats across seven projects** - Waiting times range from 34 to 45 months, with 4-room flats starting from S$312,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-2026-bto-review/)
